messages:
eli_account_exec: FYI prospect 'NovaCare Systems' requested detailed IAM artifacts as part of their vendor-risk intake. They need: SSO/SAML metadata and step-by-step config, proof MFA is enforced for admin roles, RBAC role export, SCIM provisioning examples, and a brief least-privilege justification. POC demo Fri 9am. Can we assemble by Thu EOD?
sara_security: Confirming this is for hosted SaaS. We cannot share raw customer logs; provide redacted samples and a written description of retention and redaction rules. Will need legal sign-off for attestation wording.
tony_engineer: I can export RBAC CSV from staging and craft a sanitized SCIM event. I need a support ticket with the demo org_id and approval on redaction fields (emails, IPs, device ids).
tonys_example: CLI to export roles:
```
TOKEN="$API_TOKEN"
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/<org_id>/roles?format=csv" \n  -o nova-roles.csv
```
matt_solutions: Let's create a tidy "IAM Evidence Pack": one ZIP with: SAML metadata XML, SSO setup screenshot + bullets, MFA policy excerpt + admin enforcement screenshot, roles CSV + role editor screenshot, SCIM sample JSON (sanitized) and a 1-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ control IDs. Keep it tight.
viv_cs: I'll open the ticket now and get the demo org_id. Also will ask AE to confirm they accept redacted SCIM events instead of full logs.
sara_security: MFA note: service accounts use long-lived API tokens and do not prompt for MFA. We'll include that explanation and mitigations (scoped tokens, rotation, and KMS storage).
tonys_engineer: Draft SCIM sample (sanitized):
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Event"],
  "id":"evt-12345",
  "type":"UserCreated",
  "timestamp":"2026-02-10T18:23:12Z",
  "data":{
    "userName":"jane.doe@example.com",
    "externalId":"user-789",
    "active":true
  }
}
```
(This will be redacted to remove actual email domain per legal guidance.)
sara_security: We'll include a short attestation: statement of control ownership, what we can and cannot provide (no raw PII logs), and contact for further questions. Legal: do we need a wet signature or is signed PDF ok?
matt_solutions: PDF signed by security lead is usually fine. I can annotate screenshots to highlight MFA toggle and role bindings.
viv_cs: Ticket SUP-4892 created for nova-demo (org_id: nova-demo). I added legal and AE. Target: bundle draft by Thu 5pm.
eli_account_exec: Great — please post bundle link here when ready and I'll share with NovaCare buyer. Thanks team!
